headline: RBI Sets April 1 Effective Date for Basel Leverage Ratio Norms
summary: The Reserve Bank of India announced that the updated leverage ratio framework issued by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision will take effect on April 1.
why: Basel leverage standards govern bank capital buffers, setting limits on balance-sheet expansion relative to Tier-1 capital.

impacts.name: Banking
impacts.why: Tighter leverage ratios improve balance sheet resilience but may constrain balance sheet growth.
